# Kaizan

> Kaizan is client super intelligence for professional services firms: AI that turns client conversations and data into early warnings on relationship health, churn risk and growth opportunities.

## Key pages

- [Our Story: Intelligence for Client Service](https://kaizan.ai/about/): Why Glen Calvert and Pravin Paratey founded Kaizan in London: a proactive system of intelligence for client service and account management teams.
- [Agency profitability | Blog](https://kaizan.ai/blog/agency-profitability/): Protect revenue, save time and grow margin across your client portfolio.
